inventoryOnly.reason: Select the intended object by its 16-byte name and type before using an object-edit frame. No implicit object switch or query is issued.

inventoryOnly.name: Sample key range low / V2 sentinel
inventoryOnly.reason: V2 prints P2=10 for both high and low, conflicting with the original P2=11. The low write is omitted, not guessed.

inventoryOnly.name: Program LFO reset channel / note
inventoryOnly.reason: V2 change table labels signed sentinel values as UC; exact wire representation is not inferred from the bulk table.

inventoryOnly.name: Program effect type and algorithm parameters
inventoryOnly.reason: V2 expands the effect inventory; no replacement type maximum or universal parameter domain is given in the selected change table.

inventoryOnly.name: Wave addresses, lengths and sample count / links
inventoryOnly.reason: Structural edits are outside this controller-assignment catalogue.
